title: A session archives itself at its own move into done (155)
description: A session archives itself at its own move into done (155)
acceptance_criteria: Issue #155 option D (Leif, relayed by orc 2026-11-06), under DRIVE-13 and DRIVE-3, in REQ-history-006: the move into done archives the active session itself in its own change and clears the active pointer (applied.session_archive archived); a session with unfolded inbox entries stays open (kept_open); a session with release authorized at done stays open for the release and archives itself at the move from release into done; without sessions it reports skipped; next then refuses naming chough session new <key>, and a following session new archives nothing. The one-time sweep moves the done sessions open on main into the archive in this change. The new tests fail first; the switch tests in tests/sessions.rs model a done session left open by an older version, with no assertion change, docs and the skill say so, and fledge lanes run verify passes on Linux.

answers.constraints: DRIVE-13 ('each closes at done and is archived') and DRIVE-3 ('automatic archiving of a finished session'); issue #155 option D chosen by Leif; REQ-history-006's kept-open rule for unfolded inbox entries; REQ-history-011, REQ-cli-041/043/049 order unchanged; checkpoint_path's vanished-session refusal kept for other commands.
